stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2024 entering class). No public Common Data Set was found: Seattle University's Institutional Data Resource Sheet says the Common Data Set is on its Redhawk Hub (SharePoint) site, which asks for a Seattle University sign-in. Counts are from the IPEDS admissions file (via the Urban Institute API mirror): 8,468 applicants, 6,514 admitted, 888 enrolled (883 full-time + 5 part-time); College Navigator shows 77% admitted and 14% of those admitted enrolled. International applicant counts, residency split, GPA and class rank are not published there. College Navigator: 8% of enrolled first-years (68 students) submitted SAT and 1% (11) ACT, so the SAT/ACT percentiles below describe a small test-submitting group (Seattle University is test-optional). The admissions site's own 'middle 50% among admitted students' is SAT 1160-1360 and ACT 24-30, an older class-profile figure not used here. Undergraduate enrollment (4,078) and U.S. nonresident undergraduates (304) are IPEDS fall 2024 EF figures; the Scorecard file lists 4,062. College Navigator shows a 10:1 student-faculty ratio; the admissions site says 11:1. Academic calendar: Seattle University is moving from quarters to semesters from Summer 2027, so students entering in fall 2027 are on semesters (https://www.seattleu.edu/who-we-are/move-to-semesters/).

cost.notes: College Scorecard (data released 2026-10-15; IPEDS charges for 2025-26, which match the 2025-26 cost tables published by Berea, Pitzer and Scripps): tuition includes required fees; on-campus cost of attendance.
